title: Stalled tenant upgrades from environment-specific config overrides — urgent hotpatch and reconciliation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple Private/VPC customers reported tenant upgrades stalling during our operator-driven Helm rollout when tenant-specific helm value overrides were present. The operator reconciler skipped the pre-migration hook for ~7% of tenants where override keys differed in casing or contained additional nested keys. Symptoms: controller enters a 'waiting' state for the tenant CR, HelmRelease shows 'pending', and the node-level agent reports init-container timeout (sidecar ordering appears unrelated but surfaced during repro). Impact: three enterprise customers experienced blocked upgrades and degraded API availability for short windows; capacity autoscaling was impacted for one tenant. This ticket coordinates the urgent hotpatch, rollout, customer comms, and long-term reconciliation work.
updates: 2026-03-10 - Asha Patel: Pager triggered from customer X at 05:12 UTC. Initial triage showed HelmRelease stuck at 'pending' and operator logs contain 'preMigration hook skipped: validation mismatch'. Created this ticket to own cross-team coordination.

2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor: Reproduced locally by applying tenant helm values with an extra 'tls.enabled' camelCase key; reconciler code path normalized keys to snake_case leading to an early return. Added log context in branch fix/operator-672411-key-normalization.

2026-03-11 - SRE Lead (Marta Ruiz): Deployed temporary mitigation: operator-side feature-flag 'strict-hook-guard=false' to hosted-dedicated control plane to force hook execution even on validation mismatch. Rolled to 2 clusters (staging + customer-staging). Monitoring dashboards in grafana show immediate reduction in stuck upgrades.

2026-03-11 - Eng: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/12345 (hotfix) to normalize helm override keys and add idempotent pre-migration guard. PR includes unit tests and an e2e scenario that mirrors customer YAMLs.

2026-03-12 - Support (Ravi Shah): Notified affected customers with short RCA and immediate mitigation steps; one customer requested rollback which was executed successfully using our safe-rollforward script.

2026-03-13 - Release: Cut operator-2.9.1-hotfix image (sha: sha256:abcd1234). Canary rollout to 10% of onprem tenants via the curated rollout job. Observability hooks added to track hook execution rate and helmrelease pending time.
2026-03-13 - QA (Jules Park): Smoke tests passed on canary cluster. Found a corner case when nested map keys included hyphens; added integration tests and updated PR.
2026-03-13 - Product (Nina Gomes): Prepared customer-facing incident note and postmortem outline in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/ENG-672411+Upgrade+Reconciliation+Incident
action_items: Apply hotfix operator-2.9.1-hotfix to remaining canary cohorts and monitor hook execution metrics for 48h.
Backfill stuck HelmReleases for affected tenants using the reconciliation script: scripts/reconcile-helmrelease-keys.sh (ad-hoc run for impacted customer namespaces).
Add normalization and canonicalization utilities in the operator to handle client-provided helm overrides (merge strategy and case-insensitive key mapping).
Ship e2e tests that simulate tenant-specific overrides with camelCase, snake_case, hyphen-keys and nested maps in CI gating for operator changes.
Coordinate with Support to finalize customer postmortem and SLA impact calculations; prepare credits if required.
Plan longer-term: introduce a preflight validator that warns about incompatible overrides before upgrades are scheduled.
Schedule a 90-minute retro with SRE, Runtime, Operator and Support to reduce future upgrade surface area (owner: Liam).
root_cause_summary: Operator pre-migration hook validation used a strict key-match check against canonicalized chart values. Tenant-specific overrides containing alternate key casing and additional nested keys caused the validation to fail and the hook to be skipped. The skip left HelmRelease in pending state and prevented the rest of the upgrade plan from progressing.
mitigation_done: Feature-flagged operator change to ignore strict validation in control plane for immediate relief (rolled to staging and two customer clusters).
Applied reconciliation script to 6 affected tenant namespaces to re-run pre-migration and unstick HelmRelease objects.
Cut and released operator-2.9.1-hotfix with canonicalization logic and additional logging for debugging similar cases.
Customer communication sent with mitigation steps and ETA for full rollout.
Added dashboard panels: 'helmrelease_pending_rate' and 'pre_migration_hook_execution_rate' for real-time monitoring.
Executed safe rollback for one tenant at customer request (no data loss reported).
follow_up_tasks: Merge PR and remove feature flag after 72h of stable canary monitoring.
Implement preflight validator in UI/CLI to catch incompatible overrides during upgrade scheduling (PM story: PM-7112).
Audit existing tenant override patterns and produce guidance doc for customers with recommended keys and example manifests.
Add a migration-compatibility step to the operator that records a deterministic fingerprint of override keys to avoid future silent skips.
Include this failure pattern in onboarding docs for Solutions Engineers and CSMs to reduce future escalations.
Postmortem write-up and timeline to be published in Confluence and sent to affected customers by 2026-03-20.
